1.w: For behold, the Lord YHWH of hosts is turning away from Jerusalem and from Judah the staff and support—the whole staff of bread, and the whole staff of water—

2.w: the mighty one and the man of war, the judge and the prophet, and the diviner and the elder,

3.w: the captain of fifty, and the lifted up of faces, and the counselor, and the cunning magician, and the discerning charmer.

4.w: “And I will give youths as their princes, and infants will rule over them.”

5.w: And the people will be oppressed, each man by a man and each man by his neighbor; the child will rage against the elder, and the one despised against the honored.

6.w: For a man will take hold on his brother in the house of his father: “A cloak [is] unto you—the chief you will be for us, and this heap of ruins [is] under your hand;”

7.w: he will lift up in that day to say, “I will not be one binding [wounds], and in my house there is no bread and no garment; you⁺ shall not set me [as] chief of the people.”

8.w: For Jerusalem has stumbled, and Judah has fallen, because their tongue and their deeds [are] against YHWH, defying the eyes of His glory.

9.w: The look of their faces answers against them, and their sin like Sodom they declare—they do not hide [it]! Woe to their soul, for they have brought evil upon themselves.

10.w: Say to the righteous that [it is] good, for the fruit of their deeds they will eat.

11.w: Woe to the wicked—evil; for the recompense of his hands will be done to him!

12.w: My people—their oppressors [are] foolish children, and women rule over them. O My people, those who guide you lead [you] astray, and the way of your paths they have swallowed up.

13.w: YHWH Is taking [His] stand to contend, and is standing to judge the peoples.

14.w: YHWH will enter into judgment with the elders of His people and His princes: “And you⁺—you⁺ have consumed the vineyard; the plunder of the poor [is] in your⁺ houses.

15.w: Why do you crush My people, and grind the faces of the poor?” A declaration of the Lord YHWH of hosts.

16.w: And says YHWH: “Because that the daughters of Zion are haughty, and they walk with outstretched neck and wanton eyes, walking and skipping [as] they go, and with their feet jingling,

17.w: and the Lord will bring scabs [to] the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and YHWH will make their foreheads bare.

18.w: That in the day the Lord will turn away the beauty of the anklets and the headbands, and the crescents,

19.w: the pendants, and the bracelets, and the veils,

20.w: the headdresses, and the armlets, and the sashes, and the boxes of perfume, and the charms,

21.w: the signet rings, and nose rings,

22.w: the [festive] robes, and the tunics, and the cloaks, and the purses,

23.w: and the mirrors, and the linen [garments], and the turbans, and the veils.

24.w: And it will come to pass, instead of of spice, [that] there will be rottenness; and instead of a belt, a rope; and instead of worked hair, baldness; and instead of a fine robe, a girding of sackcloth; and shame instead of beauty.

25.w: Your men will fall by the sword, and your mighty ones in battle;

26.w: and her gates will lament and mourn and she will be left empty—on the ground she will sit.
